artifact_version: VN Companion RC29.73 · Travel Engine 25.7.2 Guide Auto-Sync + Derived Timeline Next Stop Root Candidate
capabilities_changed: Adds Engine-level shared Documents capability to VN.
Documents root is the shared/default filing location; no ALL folder is rendered.
Participant folders are generated from TRIP_CONFIG and render only when populated.
Document filing is classification only and remains separate from uploader ownership and Studio booking-link management.
Existing VN collaborative Booking, cashback/payment, Qspa D1-D3 and itinerary contracts are preserved.
Preserves the six-category NZ Documents contract in VN.
Timeline attachment selection is now Day → Event instead of one whole-trip flat list.
Timeline event choices show time + title and only events from the selected day.
Keeps all six bottom navigation destinations on one row, including narrow mobile viewports.
VN currency converter defaults to 10,000 VND.
VN collaborative users can select Booking or Timeline links when uploading/editing Documents.
Document link editor hides Booking/Day/Event controls until their Attach to mode is selected.
Browser double-submit smoke restores its BOOKING_AUTHORITY wrapper between viewport runs.
Booking detail surfaces linked Documents and opens the linked file in Documents.
Documents renders cached local metadata before background sync and lazy-loads PDF.js only when a PDF is opened.
Guide Save is local-first and auto-syncs across devices through trip_guides; Timeline Publish does not own Guide.
Timeline TO NEXT STOP destination is derived from current Timeline order after move/add/delete/edit.
For a trusted route with walking time <=15 minutes, Timeline shows both Walk and Grab estimates; otherwise it shows Grab only.
Derived next-stop Directions opens Google Maps from the current stop to the derived next stop.
VN Timeline cards render start time only while retaining end time in itinerary data.
VN Directions resolve only from Vietnam-scoped address/map-query authority and fail closed instead of geocoding bare titles near the user home location.
Derived next-stop presentation is compacted to the NZ-style Timeline hierarchy.
obsolete_or_rejected: historical shared Trip/Guide overlay geometry ownership
release_status: RC29.73 CANDIDATE — Guide auto-sync + derived Timeline next stop
changes: Integrated documents-runtime.js and documents-folder-ui.js as Engine 25.7.2 shared modules.
Added VN Documents page and navigation entry.
Upload defaults to Documents root and can file under Christal, Crystal, Mero or Vivian.
Added trip_documents / trip-documents sync configuration scoped by VN trip_id.
No NZ RC25.7.33 production file was modified.
Replaced flat Documents Timeline target list with Attach to → Timeline event → Day → Event.
Added CI regression coverage for category add/edit round-trip, pin, links, viewer and authority parity.
Added trip_guides Guide sync authority and removed Guide overrides from publication payload.
Replaced authored Timeline next-stop destination rendering with order-derived next stop + Maps directions.
Added Vietnam-scoped route-location guard and map-query fallback to prevent ambiguous names resolving near Melbourne/Doncaster.
Timeline card time rail now renders start time only; underlying schedule ranges are preserved.
